name: Sudden
body:
Price +1 Bonus; Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A sudden weapon can be drawn as a free action. If you are wielding a sudden weapon you also gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls with the weapon against creatures who have not yet acted in combat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +1 Bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells Improved Initiative, cat’s grace
